thesis: Next-symbol prediction is an objective shared by different memory mechanisms, not proof of causal understanding or guaranteed validity.
role: Locate the proposed program among existing predictive architectures.

ideas.statement: Prediction must compare context memory with recurrent state, distinguishing designer-supplied structure from learned structure.
Good probabilities do not guarantee invariant-preserving generation; estimation, imposed constraints and verification require separate evaluation.

evidenceAndExamples.statement: Predictive State Representations anticipate action-observation sequences, linking memory with experimentation.

objectionsAndQualifications.statement: Action coverage and identifiability restrict predictive representations; a stack supplied by a designer is not autonomously discovered.

audit.notes: Complete batch read; headings and navigation excluded from idea ranking.
